shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak user_rolemapping with the Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect I(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with I(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: cid
options.description: ID of the client whose role is to be mapped. This parameter is not required for updating or deleting the rolemapping but providing it reduces the number of API calls required. If neither O(cid) nor O(client_id) is specified, a B(realm) role is mapped instead.

options.name: client_id
options.description: Name of the client (different than O(cid)) whose role is to be mapped. This parameter is required if O(cid) is not provided (can be replaced by O(cid) to reduce the number of API calls that must be made). If neither O(cid) nor O(client_id) is specified, a B(realm) role is mapped instead.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: realm
options.description: They Keycloak realm under which this role_representation resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: roles
options.description: Roles to be mapped to the user.

options.name: service_account_user_client_id
options.description: Client ID of the service-account-user to be mapped. This parameter is not required for updating or deleting the rolemapping but providing it reduces the number of API calls required.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the user_rolemapping. On V(present), the user_rolemapping is created if it does not yet exist, or updated with the parameters you provide. On V(absent), the user_rolemapping is removed if it exists.

options.name: target_username
options.description: Username of the user roles are mapped to. This parameter is not required (can be replaced by uid for less API call).

options.name: uid
options.description: ID of the user to be mapped. This parameter is not required for updating or deleting the rolemapping but providing it reduces the number of API calls required.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
